run_stt_client: run the speech to text client with a WebRTC server identity to transcribe audio in real time
setup_action_engine: configure the action engine with STT serialisers and automatic reader deserialisation settings
create_webrtc_stream: create a WebRTC stream connecting a client identity to a signalling server URL
create_session_with_action_registry: create an action engine session with a node map and dispatch from a WebRTC stream
record_audio_with_realtime_stt: record audio chunks using AudioToTextRecorder and stream them into an action input for transcription
